name: A practical joke
blurb: Something with a bucket, a goose and a burgher's dignity. Claes's speciality; the town has a long memory for them.

name: Cardsharping at the Bear
blurb: Marked cards and a sailor three cups gone. The landlord takes a cut of anything he notices.

name: Lift a purse at the Waterhalle
blurb: The halle is thick with Lucchese silk-buyers whose purses are thicker. The sergeants know it too.

name: Run a barge past the Damme toll
blurb: A night tide, a bribed lock-keeper, and a cargo the Duke's receiver never sees.

name: Smuggle Spanish alum
blurb: The papal monopoly on Tolfa alum makes every other source contraband, and every other source cheap.

name: Forge a bill on a Medici factor
blurb: A bill of exchange is only paper and a hand everyone trusts. Tommaso Portinari's hand is very trusted.

name: Read a cipher letter that is not yours
blurb: Every house in Bruges writes to Venice in code. Knowing what St Pol tells his factor is worth more than the letter's weight in gold.

name: Divert a Florentine galley's cargo
blurb: Paperwork, a compliant captain and a second set of bills of lading. The galley arrives; the silk does not.
